factions.name: Red
factions.description: Aggressive, well-statted units built to overwhelm opponents early; comparatively weaker spells as a tradeoff.

factions.name: Blue
factions.description: The control color; weak early heroes that scale into big, flashy board-wiping spells.

factions.name: Black
factions.description: Specializes in hero assassination and removal; powerful targeted effects and replacement tricks.

factions.name: Green
factions.description: The support color; summons and buffs creeps to grind out board advantage over time.

cards.name: Axe
cards.description: Red Bruiser hero with high armor (2) and no active ability; one of the game's most iconic and valuable cards.

cards.name: Sven
cards.description: Sturdy early red hero with high health, used to anchor aggressive red lanes.

cards.name: Legion Commander
cards.description: Aggressive red hero known for the Duel mechanic in her signature card, forcing one-on-one combat.

cards.name: Storm Spirit
cards.description: Black hero whose signature card lets him reposition between lanes.

cards.name: Tinker
cards.description: High-attack, low-health black hero favoring burst damage over survivability.

cards.name: Bounty Hunter
cards.description: Assassination-focused black hero: Jinada gives a 50% chance at +4 Attack, and Track marks a hero for +5 bonus damage until it dies.

cards.name: Necrophos
cards.description: Black hero that gains +1 Health whenever an enemy neighbor dies, scaling in prolonged fights.

cards.name: Zeus
cards.description: Blue hero dealing 1 piercing damage to adjacent enemies whenever an allied spell or enchantment is played in the lane.

cards.name: Drow Ranger
cards.description: Green hero built around ranged aura buffs for allied units.

cards.name: Chen
cards.description: Green support hero whose Holy Persuasion ability can take control of an enemy creep.

cards.name: Satyr Magician
cards.description: Blue creep that fully restores its tower's mana when activated, enabling spell-heavy blue decks.

cards.name: Ogre Corpse Tosser
abilities: Deploy: Tower damage on melee creep death
cards.description: High-health red creep that deals 2 piercing damage to the enemy tower whenever an allied melee creep dies.

cards.name: Town Portal Scroll
cards.description: 3-gold consumable item that returns an allied hero to the Fountain, healing and repositioning them.

cards.name: Blink Dagger
cards.description: 7-gold weapon granting +2 Attack, with an active ability to move the equipped hero to a different lane.

cards.name: Annihilation
cards.description: Expensive blue board-wipe spell that slays every unit on both teams in the lane.

cards.name: Cheating Death
cards.description: Green improvement that can grant a unit a Death Shield to survive a killing blow, usable only with an allied green hero in the lane.

cards.name: Berserker's Call
cards.description: Basic red spell that forces an allied red hero's enemy neighbors to battle it, taunting nearby foes.
